title: Cold vs Reuse with cache-hit counters
provenance: User-supplied summary of a controlled Cold/Reuse run and vLLM metrics; transcribed from the analyst notes, not re-derived from raw server logs.

scope.note: Single Input 3950 / C1 condition; no Baseline in this run, so it is not an 8-scenario comparison against Baseline.

caveats: External prefix cache hits are cumulative counters, not the Hit Tokens added by these four requests; per-request counter deltas are still needed.
external_prefix_cache_hits_total counts tokens hit through the external KV connector (not the GPU prefix cache); it does not by itself prove the hits were served from SSD.
TPOT is almost unchanged, as expected: KV reuse saves prefill work, not necessarily each decode token.
